summary: Removes all armor points from a named hit location on a target within 20'; only armor-specific protections like Blessed Aura stop it.

effects.subject: hit-location
effects.note: The caster names the hit location in the Incantation.

properties.note: Targets the player but affects the armor on the hit location.
Immunities, Resistances and other protections only protect the armor if they specifically extend to it (e.g. Blessed Aura).

references.name: Blessed Aura
references.note: Example of a protection that extends to armor and so protects it.

references.name: Enlightened Soul
references.note: Does not extend to armor; cannot protect against Destroy Armor.

references.name: Protection from Magic
references.note: Does not extend to armor; cannot protect against Destroy Armor.

references.name: Adaptive Protection
references.note: Adaptive Protection (Death) does not extend to armor; cannot protect against Destroy Armor.

references.name: Ancestral Armor
references.note: Does not protect against verbal magic; cannot protect against Destroy Armor.

clarifications.text: Visibility (line of sight) may be drawn to any part of the target player, not only the chosen hit location.
Immunities, Resistances and other protections protect the armor only if they specifically extend to armor, such as Blessed Aura.
Enlightened Soul, Protection from Magic and Adaptive Protection (Death) do not extend to armor and cannot protect against it.
Ancestral Armor does not protect against verbal magic, so it cannot protect against Destroy Armor.
